items.title: Aircrew report fast-moving object off the Virginia coast
items.summary: Commercial crew relayed a radar-correlated contact holding position against a 40-knot headwind before accelerating out of scope. Controllers logged the return; no aircraft was on the flight plan.
items.read: Strong on paper — radar correlation plus an ATC log is the kind of hard sensor evidence that separates signal from noise; unverified until the flight-plan gap is confirmed.

items.title: Cluster of silent orbs filmed over the Arizona desert
items.summary: Multiple witnesses captured a slow triangular formation of amber lights drifting without sound for several minutes near Sedona before winking out one by one.
items.read: Multiple witnesses and footage raise the floor, but silent amber lights over a desert tourist town are a classic flare/drone confound — worth watching, not banking.

items.title: Follow-up questions filed after congressional UAP hearing
items.summary: Lawmakers submitted written questions to defence officials requesting the sensor data referenced during the latest disclosure hearing.

items.title: Daylight photo of a disc-shaped object shared online
items.summary: A commuter posted a single still frame of a metallic disc-like shape above a motorway. Analysts note the image is low-resolution and unverified.

items.title: Single bright light hovering over the coastline
items.summary: A late-night observer described a stationary white light low over the water that faded after roughly ten minutes. No corroborating footage yet.
